limitations: Full text and supplementary tables of Clin Cancer Res 24:5433 are inaccessible (closed access; Unpaywall closed; aacrjournals.org behind Cloudflare 403; no PMC copy; DiVA portal connection reset by proxy). Per-patient age, castration/ADT status (abstract: most relapsed after ADT, 5 previously untreated), BM1/BM2 subgroup, Gleason, PSA and survival therefore could not be assigned; age/ancestry left 'not available', treatment-status/subgroup columns omitted rather than broadcast (rule 18).

The PC31-PC52 -> bone metastasis assignment is inferred by exclusion (the other 36 experiments of the shared design template are deposited in the six localized-prostate-cancer PXDs; 22 remain = n of bone metastases); no source names PC31-52 explicitly.
characteristics[individual] uses the study sample code PCnn as patient pseudonym (one sample per patient per abstract); the paper's own patient numbering, if different, could not be checked.

Precursor mass tolerance 'not available': MaxQuant 1.3.7.1 parameters.txt does not record first/main-search tolerances and no mqpar.xml is deposited. Consequence: parse_sdrf convert-openms exits 1 ('Cannot read precursor mass tolerance: not available') - same as campaign precedents PXD006676/PXD024103.
Reduction/alkylation reagents not stated in the PRIDE protocol (FASP); Carbamidomethyl kept as the search declares it Fixed; reagents 'not available'.
PRIDE prose says SAX into five fractions; deposit and design template have six fractions per sample - data used.
techsdrf not installed; instrument checked from three raw headers only; collision energy not read (optional column omitted).
LNCaP sub-clone (parental vs clone FGC) not stated; SN= uses the name as published.
Organism part 'bone element' not refined to vertebra: surgery for spinal cord compression implies spine but no per-sample site is published.
